title: A founder reads Anthropic's S-1 through the book — 'The shareholders don't control Anthropic. A mission-aligned trust does. Even the trustees don't own it'
summary: Nelson runs FoundersForge and has started six companies. On the day Anthropic filed, he uses the book to explain why its structure interests him: ownership held by a mission-aligned trust whose trustees do not own it either, which he reads as a public benefit corporation design capable of resisting the short-term pressure that reshapes public companies. He cites a concrete test — Anthropic holding its position when the government pushed against its values — and is candid that the experiment is unproven and that data centres and job displacement remain unanswered. He opens by telling founders to read the book.
blockquote: The shareholders don’t control Anthropic. A mission-aligned trust does. Even the trustees don’t own it.
